items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Jimmy Dodd played in the band. Johnny Dodds. [INTERVIEWEE] I mean Johnny Dodds. Yeah, Johnny Dodds. Not Baby Dodds.

ctx.x: And Jimmy Dodd played in the band. Johnny Dodds.
I mean Johnny Dodds. Yeah, Johnny Dodds. Not Baby Dodds. I didn't know. No, I don't think Baby came up with King Oliver. Yes.
